title: 山门T1-T3主控返修（匾额遮挡 / 翼墙统一变换 / 肩屋面起翘与瓦垄）
scope: shanmen main body repair only; no yimen/dadian/full-temple expansion

claims.geometryAndPhysics: verified against exported GLB bytes and collision records (numbers below)
claims.visual: NOT claimed. Renders and WebGL captures are provided as evidence; the text executor performed no visual review. Final visual adoption is the lead's decision.

outputs.webglEvidence: kit/out/temple-shanmen-repair/web/ (8 real-page captures with telemetry json)
outputs.dataset: world/temple-shanmen/ (rebuilt from the repair kit; serves 5290/5291)
outputs.pilot: http://127.0.0.1:5290/temple.html (dev) and :5291 (preview) in this worktree; main street 5284/5285 untouched
outputs.oldOutputsKept: kit/out/temple-shanmen/ (S1-S7 build + lead-review web captures) and kit/out/temple-shanmen-renders/ (S6 renders) unchanged

tests.temple_shanmen_repair.test.mjs: TEMPLE_REPAIR_PASS (T1 raycast, T2 OBB-vs-vertices, T3 equation)
tests.temple_shanmen_contract.test.mjs: TEMPLE_CONTRACT_PASS (glTF validator 0 errors on all 4 GLBs, budgets, corridor, bounds, cameras, negative)
tests.temple_shanmen_passage.test.mjs: TEMPLE_PASSAGE_PASS (3x3.1 walk-through, off-axis/door-leaf/no-plane negatives, wing OBB negative)
tests.capture_temple_web.mjs: TEMPLE_WEB_PASS (8 views, cameraCheck dPos=0 dFov=0, in-page passage check)

t1_plaque.fix: Rebuilt as ONE backing plate + four-sided stepped frame rings (outer rim z=0.155 on the plaque outline, mid rim z=0.105, text face recessed at z=0.06) + four thin gold EDGE strips riding the outer rim. The three solid full-face step boards and the full-plate gold fillet are deleted. Texture, +Z facing, and the right-to-left 隅海障保/保障海隅 reading are unchanged.

evidence.textFaceMesh: shanmen-plaque__temple-plaque-lacquer = exactly 2 triangles (the lone textured quad)
evidence.raycast: glyph-area grid 15x13 from azimuth 0/+20/-20 deg: 195/195 rays hit the text face first at EVERY azimuth; 0 rays occluded by any full-face board
evidence.method: Moller-Trumbore over every exported triangle of temple.glb with node transforms applied

t2_wingWalls.fix: make_oriented now returns ONE explicit right-handed frame (lx, +Y, lz = lx x ly) plus a viewer-side sign; obox yaws the box with the GLB-correct sign (rotation_euler=(0,0,+yaw); GLB +Y yaw == Blender same-signed +Z). Wall body, base course, coping, frame grid, relief panel, diamond strips, bosses, tile cap and OBB collision all derive from that single frame. The old lz flip (left-handed left wing) and the mirrored -yaw rotation are gone.

evidence.obbEndpoints: OBB axis endpoints match config start/end at d=0.000m for both wings
evidence.slabExtents: measured wall-slab vertices vs OBB: u 0.000..5.062 of 5.062, vMax 3.550 of 3.55, |w|max 0.165 of T/2=0.16 (both wings)
evidence.decorations: relief panel proud of the FRONT face plane 0.015..0.015m; stone decorations max proud 0.060m (design band 0.03-0.06); 0 vertices leaked to the back face
evidence.capRidge: roll end rings on the wall axis (dA=dB=0.005m), axis vs wall frame cos=1.00000
evidence.physics: passage negatives re-run on the real Rapier world: wing blocks through-passage, corridor stays clear, collision-world.json byte-identical to pre-repair records

t3_shoulderRoofs.fix: Shoulder shells now follow the DESIGN_REVISION equation: baseY(t)=ridgeY-(ridgeY-eaveBaselineY)*drop(t); y=baseY+(frontOutline(|x|)-5.95)*smoothstep(0.5,1,t)^2; rear eave keeps the 0.18m drop; ridge never elevated (no max(ridgeY,outline)). Soffits offset along the surface normal. Left-shoulder edge selection corrected (the old build closed the OUTER edge and ran the wing-edge board at the seam - the horizontal shelf the lead saw); a seam skirt now closes the center/shoulder junction. 39 finite half-round tile ribs (r=0.05, spacing 0.24m, 8 sections) ride the front slopes of the center roof and both shoulders, ending in round eave caps.

evidence.equationMatch: 484/484 shell grid vertices match the sampled revision equation, worst |dy|=0.0000m (both shoulders, front+rear)
evidence.ridgeFlat: ridge band z=-1.8 tops at exactly 7.000 (min 6.880 = soffit)
evidence.noCurtain: front rows t<=0.5 laterally flat (spread <=0.0177m incl. rib vertices); 0 curtain vertices above +0.12
evidence.noFloat: 0 vertices above the equation surface beyond the rib normal-offset allowance
evidence.ribs: 2255 rib vertices above the shell; 3978 rib triangles <= the 8000 DESIGN_REVISION allowance
evidence.seamClosure: 32/32 horizontal junction rays blocked at the closure (skirt/center shell/outer field)
evidence.silhouette: front eave column equals the outline at every knot to 1e-9 (builder-side assert); rear eave = outline-0.18

additionalRepair.centerSurfaceClamp: top_y's inline smoothstep is now clamped; the unclamped form exploded to y=61 when seam skirts sampled beyond the shell half-width (caught by the bounds contract test)
additionalRepair.degenerateTangents: thin 16-24mm wing frame strips lost their bevel; the chamfered rotated end faces produced zero-length exported tangents (glTF validator error, now 0 errors)

palette: unchanged (gray tile / gray stone / oxblood timber / restrained brass); no aging, no new materials
keptSeparate: stone lions and fish-dragon ridge ornaments remain coarse replaceable candidates (unchanged meshes, still not claimed as refined)
